cand.title: XLIX Congreso Nacional de Pediatría 2027
cand.excerpt: Venue committed; future edition/overflow relationship only.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Reinaldo Jiménez Quezada, President, and Pedro Marte Cruz, Vice-president, are verified on the event’s 2025–2027 board. They are relevant association leadership relationship/sponsor-entry contacts, not verified hotel buyers or contract signatories. The public congress channel identifies Turinter but not the individual responsible for the 2027 hotel contract.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed published upcoming edition: 24–27 June 2027, within the requested horizon. Turinter lists these as the congress dates on its homepage and as the three-night/four-day package dates on the event page; these are activity dates, not publication dates. A detailed scientific-session timetable was not located. The registration table also says “Hasta julio 2027”; that is a tariff deadline label, not evidence that the congress occurs in July.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: the all-inclusive residential format is compatible with Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana’s resort product, but the main congress is a poor full-hosting prospect. Wyndham publishes 620 guestrooms, three meeting venues, 380 m² and capacity for 300 conference/200 banquet guests; the 2023 congress was reported at more than 1,200 participants. That historical attendance is not a 2027 forecast and cannot be converted into rooms. Prioritize only a separately sized sponsor/delegation stay or small ancillary meeting if the organizer validates it; no such requirement is currently published.
findings.venueCommitments: Hotel Hard Rock Punta Cana is the announced competing host/accommodation hotel. The event-specific page sells named single/double/triple accommodation packages including three nights and all-inclusive service: stronger evidence than generic hotel marketing. Treat the public offer as a venue commitment, but the signed venue contract, exclusivity and room allotment are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: XLVII, 20–23 July 2023 at Paradisus Palma Real, Punta Cana; XLVIII, 5–8 June 2025 at Hard Rock Punta Cana; XLIX, 24–27 June 2027 at Hard Rock Punta Cana. This establishes recurrence and a two-year sequence across these editions, not an annual congress. It shows a historical hotel change within Punta Cana followed by a repeat Hard Rock listing, not a demonstrated city-rotation policy. Do not substitute the separately branded 2026 Jornada for a congress edition.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Turinter is the published accommodation/registration sales pathway through pediatria@turinter.com, telephone 809-686-4020 and WhatsApp 829-760-5758. Hard Rock packages are already advertised. No open hotel-sourcing RFP, alternate-hotel procurement invitation, overflow request, contracted room count, pickup or cutoff was located. Supplier sourcing is not established as open or formally closed; incumbent venue confirmed.
findings.organizationStructure: Sociedad Dominicana de Pediatría is the medical professional society/event owner; this is an association medical congress rather than a corporate incentive programme despite the seed segment. Turinter is the travel/congress organizing and booking channel, explicitly called “Agencia Organizadora” on the society’s separately branded 2026 Jornada page and selling the 2027 congress package. Hard Rock is the competing host hotel, not the owner or identified buyer. Contract authority between society and agency remains unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hard Rock is already marketed for both the 2025 and 2027 editions. Wyndham’s published 300-person conference capacity is materially below the reported 2023 participation level; outdoor space does not establish equivalent plenary/exhibition capacity. No sourced sellout, overflow, dissatisfaction, room shortage or release of hotel inventory was found. Off-site attendance access, transport arrangements and economics are unknown.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Turinter’s congress desk first at pediatria@turinter.com / 809-686-4020, referencing 24–27 June 2027 and acknowledging Hard Rock’s incumbent position. Ask for the named accommodation decision-maker, whether any authorized off-site/sponsor/delegation room need exists, applicable access/transfer rules, and the next competitive selection window. Seek an introduction to Reinaldo Jiménez Quezada and Pedro Marte Cruz through the society/event secretariat for relationship development, without claiming either controls procurement. Offer a capacity-specific all-inclusive brief, not a full-congress replacement bid; only quote rooms after the need and accessibility are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, delegate registration/accommodation is advertised through Turinter, but that does not make hotel procurement accessible. No evidence establishes an available main block for Wyndham, an overflow requirement or permission for off-site delegates. Classify as venue confirmed elsewhere; conditional relationship enquiry only, not forecastable current-edition room demand.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the 2023-to-2025 hotel change supports exploring whether future residential or smaller associated programmes are contestable. There is no verified post-2027 edition, date, tender or venue-selection window, and no basis to publish a 2028 congress or assume an annual cycle. Full-congress capture would require independently verified capacity fit; a room-led subprogramme is the more plausible product-fit hypothesis, not evidenced demand.
